export const warpF = (g: number): number => {
  if (g <= 0) return T[0] + (T[1] - T[0]) * g;
  const n = T.length - 1;
  if (g >= n) return T[n] + (T[n] - T[n - 1]) * (g - n);
  const i = Math.floor(g), u = g - i;
  return T[i] + (T[i + 1] - T[i]) * u;
};
